design.biological_unit: one physical donor represented by one GSM accession, verified by the unique adult CITE-seq Donor IDs in Nature Supplementary Table 1
design.split_rule: within each deposited clinical stratum, ascending SHA256('gse279451-hierarchical-v1' + GSM accession); first floor(n/2) development, remainder held
design.cell_selection_rule: retain the first 1,024 barcodes after ascending SHA256('GSE279451-CELL-BUDGET-v1' + accession + sample + barcode)
design.rna_state: raw UMI count greater than zero
design.adt_state: per-donor deterministic lower/upper midrank with exactly 512 lower cells and SHA256 tie breaking
design.primary_cell_qc: none; malformed or source-inconsistent axes are terminal refusals
design.rna_graph_profile: per-marker donor vector of binary detection prevalence, centered and scaled within each development training fold
design.adt_graph_profile: per-marker donor vector of mean per-cell log1p(100 * marker count / nine-marker ADT total), centered and scaled within each development training fold
design.primary_support_gate: every donor must have at least 64 of 81 margin-informative entities on its fixed 1,024-cell axis
design.all_cells_analysis: secondary sensitivity only after the held decision; it cannot reselect or alter the primary decision

selection.rule: all hyperparameters and the strongest classical residual are selected by donor-level leave-one-out CV over the 19 development donors; every fold refits preprocessing, graphs, and estimators on 18 donors
selection.final_refit: one refit on all 19 development donors
selection.bootstrap: 20,000 donor resamples from NumPy default_rng(20260828), shared within phase; linear 0.025/0.975 quantiles
selection.relative_reduction: (donor-equal comparator mean deviance - donor-equal primary mean deviance) / donor-equal comparator mean deviance
selection.held_sign_flip: exhaustive 2^21 sign vectors on donor loss differences; inclusive lower tail of the donor-equal mean; zero ties duplicated in denominator
selection.primary: donor-heterogeneity-aware exact fixed-margin hierarchical conditional log odds
